categories.main_business_segments: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of advanced copper alloy materials and products. Key segments include high-strength high-conductivity copper alloys and products, medium and high-voltage electrical contact materials and products, high-performance metal chromium powder, CT and DR tube components for medical imaging, optical module chip bases and housings, and liquid rocket engine thrust chamber inner walls. The company serves industries such as rail transit, aerospace, power electronics, medical imaging, and semiconductors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including vacuum induction melting, vacuum self-consuming electric arc melting, vacuum sintering, vacuum infiltration, 3D printing, atmospheric protection continuous casting, vacuum atomization, vacuum electromagnetic levitation melting, electroslag remelting, and hot isostatic pressing. It has proprietary technologies in copper alloy design, modification, flexible manufacturing, and precision non-standard deep processing. Key innovations include 3D printing of copper alloys, laser surface remelting, and advanced powder metallurgy.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Major customers include global industry leaders such as GE Group, Wabtec Group, Siemens, Alstom, Schneider Electric, ABB, Eaton, China CRRC, and leading medical imaging companies like United Imaging Healthcare. The company serves high-end markets in commercial aerospace, rail transit, power grid equipment, medical imaging devices, semiconductors, and emerging fields like controlled nuclear fusion and satellite internet launch vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, and has expanded internationally with manufacturing bases in Thailand and Singapore. It serves domestic and international markets, including Europe, the United States, RCEP member countries, and the Middle East. Export sales accounted for approximately 26% of revenue, with active efforts to expand global market share.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials is positioned upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of advanced copper alloy materials and precision components. It supplies critical raw materials and components to downstream manufacturers in aerospace, rail transit, power equipment, medical imaging, and semiconductor industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with strategic R&D in advanced copper alloys, high-voltage electrical contact materials, high-purity chromium powders, medical imaging components, and aerospace materials. It invests heavily in 3D printing, powder metallurgy, hot isostatic pressing, and laser surface treatment technologies. Collaboration with top universities and research institutes supports breakthroughs in materials for commercial aerospace, AI data centers, medical imaging, semiconductors, and controlled nuclear fusion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of advanced copper alloy materials, electrical contact products, metal powders, medical imaging components, and aerospace parts. The company operates a direct sales model, providing customized, non-standard products tailored to client specifications. Export sales contribute significantly to revenue, alongside domestic sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shaanxi Sirui is a leading player in multiple niche advanced materials segments, holding top market shares domestically and significant presence internationally. It is recognized as a national champion in copper-chromium electrical contact materials and a major supplier to global aerospace and rail transit companies. Competitors include international and domestic advanced materials manufacturers, but Sirui maintains a technological and market leadership position through continuous innovation and strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately RMB 1.33 billion, representing a 12.73% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 114.24 million, up 16.17%, with net cash from operating activities of RMB 169.52 million. Total assets reached RMB 2.13 billion, growing 24.39% from the prior year. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, R&D investment, and asset base, reflecting robust operational expansion and financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shaanxi Sirui offers high-performance, high-strength, and high-conductivity copper alloy materials and precision components with superior electrical, thermal, and mechanical properties. Its products enable critical applications in aerospace, rail transit, power grids, medical imaging, and semiconductors, often replacing imports. The company differentiates through proprietary advanced manufacturing technologies, customized solutions, strong R&D capabilities, and a commitment to sustainable, green manufacturing practices aligned with national strategic priorities.
